title: Google says criminal hackers used AI to find a major software flaw
summary: Google reported that criminal hackers successfully used AI-powered tools to discover and exploit a major software vulnerability, marking a significant escalation in AI-assisted cyber attacks. This development highlights the evolving threat landscape where AI is being weaponized to accelerate vulnerability discovery and exploitation.
problem_solved: The article addresses the emerging cybersecurity threat of AI-assisted vulnerability discovery by criminal actors.
why_valuable: This reporting provides critical awareness about the democratization of hacking through AI, enabling security teams to better prepare defenses against AI-powered attack vectors.
